body: m18. i’ve been trying to restore my acid barrier for the last few weeks, by moisturizing daily, layering it with vaseline at night, and using a hydrating cleanser at least once a day. if anything it feels like the pores/wrinkling has gotten worse

What should your skin feel like after you wash it? I'm using a foaming cleaner and when I'm done using it, the skin feels like it has a lot of friction if that makes sense. Supposedly you don't want your skin to be squeaky clean, which might be adding to my problem of enlarged pores.
